name: Government Contractor Certification (CMMC L2 + FedRAMP Moderate)
description: Certification target for organizations operating as government contractors or cloud service providers requiring simultaneous CMMC Level 2 and FedRAMP Moderate compliance posture. Activates all 39 common AKSI controls with strict thresholds on identity (PR-01), data protection (PR-04), and detection (DE-01) to satisfy C3PAO assessment and FedRAMP ATO documentation requirements. Suitable for contractors handling CUI and providing cloud services to federal agencies.

operator_action_required.description: System Security Plan (SSP) covering CUI scope must be documented and approved by senior security official per CMMC CA.L2-3.12.1. Ancilis evidence feeds SSP Appendix sections.
FedRAMP Authorization to Operate (ATO) or P-ATO must be pursued with a 3PAO. Ancilis continuous monitoring evidence supports ConMon deliverables.
Plan of Action & Milestones (POA&M) must be maintained for all open findings per CMMC CA.L2-3.12.2 and FedRAMP CA-5. Ancilis evidence identifies control gaps.
